oracle.statement: POST payload/clear with body {} on a collection holding 2 payload-bearing points returns 4xx (per request_required_paths anyOf: points|filter|shard_key); a 200 is adjudicated by scroll readback — payloads still deep-equal baseline after grace polls = Type1_IllegalSuccess (no-op ack on selector-less wipe), any payload gone = Type4_StateLogicViolation (unbounded bulk wipe); 5xx = Type3_RuntimeFailure with /healthz re-check; 4xx without any selector-keyword in the error body = Type2_PoorDiagnostics
